subject: Urgent: Fleet surge mediation for Spectra Labs - reserved capacity ask
messages:
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
From: Amira Hassan <amira@spectralabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Subject: Spectra reserved capacity request + go-live window

Karthik —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our execs are asking for a firm plan: Spectra wants Dedicated capacity (8xA100 equivalent) to be available by Apr 15 for our Q2 product launch. We understand there may be lead times and constraints in your fleet.

Could you confirm:
- feasibility of a guaranteed pool (8 GPUs, 12h sustained peak) for Apr 15–Jun 30
- estimated uplift to our commit and any timing risks

We need this for our internal release gating. If there are critical conflicts with other customers, please flag so we can consider a phased rollout.

Attached: preliminary load profile and expected token/sec. Happy to set up an ops call this week.

—Amira
Director, Platform Ops
Spectra Labs

Attachments: spectra_capacity_plan_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Hassan <amira@spectralabs.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Spectra reserved capacity request + go-live window

Amira —

Appreciate the details and the timeline. Short answer: feasible but contingent on current capacity commitments and a couple of mitigation options. I'm looping in Lauren (sales ops) and Marcus (capacity planning) to assess immediate lift vs. rebalancing.

Next steps from our side:
- Marcus will run a slot-level conflict check and propose allocation trades or burst options by Wed 24 Feb.
- Lauren will price the short-term surge and update the commit amendment.
- If conflicts exist we may need to prioritize based on SLA tier + strategic considerations; we'll share a recommendation.

Can you confirm whether Spectra can accept a staged ramp (4 GPUs on Apr 15, remainder by Apr 29) if we cannot commit full 8 by Apr 15? That helps a lot.

Karthik
VP, Sales 
Redwood Inference
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 11:28:00 -08:00
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Subject: RE: Spectra reserved capacity request + go-live window

Team —

I ran the slot-level simulation against our reservations & expected Q2 bursts. Summary:
- We have 36 A100-eq GPUs reserved across three existing committed accounts in the Apr 10–May 10 window. Peak overlap probability with Spectra's 12h sustained pattern is high (p>0.7).
- Options: (A) Reassign 8 GPUs from a flexible customer (low SLA) for Apr 15–Apr 29 then return; (B) Offer Spectra a mixed pool: 4 guaranteed + 4 burst-banked (best-effort) with automatic fallback; (C) Quantization/instance-sharing technical mitigation to reduce Spectra's committed GPU count from 8 -> 6 effective.

Risks: reassigning requires contract-level approval and may trigger credits/penalties. Burst-banked approach is lowest immediate ops friction but exposes Spectra to risk during contiguous peak events. Quantization requires workload validation (1–2 week evaluation).

I attached a proposed priority matrix that models lost-revenue vs. SLA tier. If leadership wants to prioritize Spectra over the flexible account, we can implement a one-time reassignment and track make-good credits.

Attachments: proposed_priority_matrix.csv (csv)

-Marcus
Principal, Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 13:05:00 -0800
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Hassan <amira@spectralabs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Subject: Pricing + contract options for Spectra surge

Amira —

Quick pricing note while we triage capacity: for a dedicated 8-GPU pool for 11 weeks our back-of-envelope uplift is ~
- incremental monthly commitment: $68k/month
- one-time surge fee (operational priority + guaranteed reservation): $15k

If Spectra can accept the staged ramp (4 + 4), we can reduce first-month uplift by ~35%. I'll update the formal amendment after Marcus' final allocation recommendation.

Also tagging the contract team if you anticipate needing credits/penalty language changes.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 09:47:00 -08:00
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Subject: Internal: leadership decision request - Spectra prioritization

Folks —

We have a time-sensitive decision. Spectra is on a strong trajectory (strategic account with potential expanded ARR). They are requesting guaranteed 8 GPUs by Apr 15. Marcus' sim shows a tradeoff vs. a flexible customer with a lower SLA.

Please review the attached priority matrix and advise:
- If we reassign the flexible customer's 8 GPUs for Apr 15–Apr 29, what is the estimated make-good exposure (credits + churn risk)?
- If we instead offer Spectra the 4+4 staged model, what's the probability of a service-impact event exceeding burst capacity?

If we cannot reach consensus by EOD Thu, escalate to execs for final guidance. We need a single path to commit to Spectra's launch calendar.

Thanks — Karthik

Attachments: proposed_priority_matrix.csv
Date: Mon, 28 Feb 2027 16:45:00 -08:00
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amira Hassan <amira@spectralabs.com>
Subject: FINAL: recommended path for Spectra (escalation closed)

All —

After running risk and commercial impact simulations and speaking with CS about the flexible account owner, recommendation is:
1) Approve a one-time reassign of 6 GPUs from the flexible pool and offer Spectra 6 guaranteed + 2 burst-banked for Apr 15. This reduces credit exposure and preserves stability for the other customer.
2) Require Spectra to accept a 2-week performance validation window (Apr 15–Apr 29) during which we will run a workload quantization test. If Spectra passes, we accelerate the handover of the remaining 2 GPUs (target May 6).
3) Offer a commercial concession: 10% credit on the first month if Spectra experiences >30m of contiguous degraded service attributable to rebalancing.

Lauren: please prepare the amendment reflecting 6 guaranteed + 2 burst with the concession. Marcus: schedule the validation runbook & monitoring play. Karthik: please confirm with Amira and close the loop.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference

-----Original message from Amira Hassan on Feb 22-----
Amira: we can accept staged approach if we get clear validation windows and the concession; we'll confirm by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments referenced: contract_redline_spectra.pdf (pdf)
